title: Decentralized Exchange Infrastructure
description: A modular decentralized exchange architecture featuring swap modules, limit orders, balance management, and oracle-driven pricing. Designed with upgradeability, security testing, and gas efficiency in mind.

title: Blockchain Backend & Indexing Services
description: Backend services for blockchain applications including event indexing, balance tracking, transaction orchestration, and API layers. Built for scalability, observability, and real-time data access.

title: Smart Contract Security & Testing
description: A collection of smart contract security patterns, testing suites, and vulnerability analysis tools. Includes reentrancy protection, invariant testing, and audit-style validations using modern Solidity tooling.
